title: Az ÁVH és a megfélemlítés (Secret Police, Andrássy út 60 & Recsk)
grammar: Authoritarian Mechanics, Totalitarian Discourse & State Terror Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the ÁVH and Andrássy út 60 were.
I can say what the deportations (kitelepítés) of the early 1950s were.
I can describe the Recsk camp and say why people dreaded the black cars.
I can use six words about state terror, such as kitelepítés and Államvédelmi Hatóság.
